Usage: wm-cli page <COMMAND>

Commands:
  get              
  list             
  create           
  delete           
  update           Update a page from a JSON object on stdin (fields: content, status, tags, title, relates_to, type, extra_frontmatter, notes, append_notes)
  link             
  unlink           
  migrate-records  
  help             Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help
